# ClearLeads

> ClearLeads (https://clearleads.co) is a B2B lead generation and appointment setting agency. We book qualified sales meetings directly onto B2B companies' calendars using done-for-you cold email and LinkedIn outreach, verified lead lists, and database reactivation. Clients are typically live within about 14 days and work month-to-month after an initial ramp.

Key facts:
- What we do: outsourced SDR / appointment setting — prospect list building, multi-channel outreach (cold email + LinkedIn), human reply handling, qualification, and meeting booking with CRM sync and weekly reporting.
- Who it's for: B2B SaaS, agencies, consultancies, professional services, recruiting, fintech, and other B2B companies with a defined ideal customer profile.
- Pricing: managed appointment-setting programs typically run $2,000–$6,000 per month on retainer; lead lists and one-time outbound system builds are quoted separately.
- Time to launch: about 14 days (inbox warm-up is the main dependency); first meetings usually within 2–4 weeks.
- Contracts: no long lock-in; month-to-month after ramp.
- Regions served: worldwide — mainly North America, the UK, Europe, and Australia (outreach runs in prospects' time zones).
- Contact: dinesh@clearleads.co · Book a strategy call: https://clearleads.co/contact.html

## Services
- [Appointment Setting](https://clearleads.co/appointment-setting.html): Qualified sales meetings booked straight to your calendar.
- [Done-For-You Cold Email](https://clearleads.co/cold-email.html): Inbox setup, deliverability, copy, sending & reply handling.
- [LinkedIn Outreach](https://clearleads.co/linkedin-outreach.html): Targeted social selling that complements your email channel.
- [Lead List Building & Data](https://clearleads.co/lead-lists.html): Verified, targeted prospect lists built to your ICP.
- [Database Reactivation](https://clearleads.co/database-reactivation.html): Revive old and cold leads with fresh, relevant sequences.
- [Outbound System Setup](https://clearleads.co/outbound-system-setup.html): A one-time build of your entire outreach machine.
